hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A chess knight toggles the color of its landing square on every single move.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Two squares of the same color can always be reached in an even number of moves.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether row sum plus column sum of both positions share the identical parity.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
